name: Amun
rootCause: On December 26, 2022, Amun's Polygon-based index token contracts were exploited when improper access controls allowed unauthorized minting and manipulation of index tokens. An estimated $300,000 was drained from protocol reserves, but no primary technical disclosure, vulnerable code, or attacker addresses are present in public sources. The index token contracts deployed on Polygon lacked sufficient access restrictions on privileged functions such as rebalancing and minting. This oversight enabled an unauthorized actor to inflate index token supply and redeem for underlying assets, draining funds.
